source_authority_rules.exact_local_artifact_available: may support exact row identity if path, scope, equation form, and term inventory are explicit
source_authority_rules.durable_repo: may support exactness only when anchored to a specific local artifact and scope
source_authority_rules.official_primary: may support external context or convention requirements, not GMUT validation by itself
source_authority_rules.peer_reviewed: may support external context, not fixture proof by itself
source_authority_rules.dataset: may support data context when schema and scope are explicit, not consciousness proof
source_authority_rules.external_context_only: context only; cannot make a row runnable
source_authority_rules.advisory_only: wording or design only; cannot support exactness
source_authority_rules.journey_context_not_canon: terminology/history/context only; cannot support physics or consciousness claims

B_Psi_rule: B_Psi remains demoted unless a separate definition artifact fixes definition, rank, units, source authority, and allowed use.
V_Psi_rule: V(Psi) remains symbolic unless a separate potential definition and dV_dPsi rule exist.
Journey_Solas_rule: Journey/Solas may appear only as journey_context_not_canon with local path/line citation before use.
